items.body: The prescribed package-wide `::prost_types` mapping omits protobuf’s primitive WKT mappings. Current shared codegen enables `compile_well_known_types()`, and the Temporal descriptor closure contains `PendingActivityInfo.use_workflow_build_id: google.protobuf.Empty` and `TaskQueueMetadata.max_tasks_per_second: google.protobuf.DoubleValue`. Changing only the package mapping generates references to nonexistent `prost_types::Empty` and `prost_types::DoubleValue`, preventing the API crate from compiling.
items.suggestion: Specify consistent prost-build default WKT mapping across runtime, Kettle and shared Temporal codegen, including `Empty → ()` and wrapper messages → primitives. Update descriptor-derived type paths accordingly and explicitly verify these two current fields.
